$Comment: Proof item of the Suspensor Belt Mk I glider route. The vanilla glider by parent (model, texture, the Glider block and the inherited Primary and SwapFrom are untouched: a left click in the air with it in hand is the vanilla glide, the control). No recipe, no durability. Utility true so it can sit in the Utility (Z) slot. One added chain, HeldOffhand (the client fires it for an item in the Utility slot): Condition Gliding false, then EffectCondition on the server signal effect Arrakis_Suspensor_Falling, then ToggleGlider. The Held and Secondary chains of the first build were removed: with three chains the glide opened and closed again a tick later (ToggleGlider is a toggle). No category change: it stays in the vanilla creative list of the parent.
